notes_for_editor: Only two pages were usable. The NHLR entry is a stub with no build date, design, staffing or history. The Central US Lookouts page for Wolf Mountain shows only the name and county in the text we could read. Two web searches for a Miller County, Arkansas tower by this name found no record; the hits were Wolf Mountain towers in Nevada County, California and Oregon, plus USGS and Komoot summit entries that do not mention a tower. The record's standing status rests only on the December 2024 register photo and is unverified. Suggested leads: Arkansas Forestry Commission records, the Arkansas digital heritage operations map, Texarkana or Miller County historical groups. Access is unknown, so no access fact is recorded.
